name: changes-story one-fix-with-risk
judge: The article tells the change (a paused reminder series stays paused; a new reminder starts its own series) and why (230 patients got reminders for cancelled appointments). Any headings name the part they introduce; none is a generic label such as 'What changed', 'Why' or 'Also in this change'. It does not repeat the risk warning (that the change adds a database column a teammate should watch on deploy), which the page shows on its own line under the body; saying what the change does for users, such as a pause surviving a restart, is fine.
